# Code, fences and ordinary product text (fixture)

The runner is given `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and never `an API key that may not be shared`.

```
A Pro subscription may not serve anyone else.
```

A standing question's AI half answers only that member's own asks, and runs only when its check finds something new.
The group's API key is reached only through the credentials module's acts, never stored outside its sealed table.
The OAuth client cannot edit its own scope.
